name: rengine-gpu
description: Two layers a game needs, in one pack. The GPU device layer: instance, physical-device selection, device, queue and memory, with render targets supplied from outside and no windowing symbol. And the resource-and-draw seam generalised from vtmb-vr's src/renderer/gpu/device.h: buffers, textures, programs, a small pipeline state and a draw, with OpenGL, Vulkan and Metal backends chosen at build time and no call-site difference between them. Charter D49/D52; specs 122-124.
note: The revision below is the commit a consumer pins, and it is rEngine's own: a project that already carries third_party/rengine receives this pack with a pin it already holds, so nothing here fetches anything (spec 111, KI-008). The version is spoken and the revision is checked, which is the two-part pin contract 9 takes (spec 107). gpu_seam.hpp is header-only C++ over the C core: a C consumer never compiles it and a C++ consumer needs no extra library.
